programs.title: The Shadow of an Empire Ep.5
programs.desc: Visit the Eastern Qing Tombs at the foot of Changrui Mountain in Zunhua, Hebei, the burial site of China's last imperial dynasty. Resting here are the Emperors Shunzhi and Kangxi, as well as the Empress Dowager Cixi and other Qing royalty. Through these tombs, the documentary brings to life the former glory and fading echoes of the Great Qing Empire.

programs.title: National Treasures · The Mystery of the Bronze Tiger
programs.desc: In 1978, a number of engraved bronze vessels were unearthed, dating back sometime between the 3-6th centuries. Each fascinating in their own right, one resembling a tiger with a gaping, circular mouth was of particular interest. Learn more about its discovery, significance and why it is now classified as a Grade One National Cultural Relic.

programs.title: I Live in Xi’an Ep.1
programs.desc: This series of short videos follows the work and lives of foreign residents in Xi'an. Through their eyes, it captures the transformation of Xi'an and Shaanxi over the past decade—telling authentic, richly textured stories of the city.
